items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. An' we'd made all kinds of records all over the country. Sometime he come to my house in Chicago an' write... sit down an' write...take my ol' number an' write some other stuff with it an' change the whole thing around.

ctx.x: So, anyway, I run into the cats had Atlantic Recording Company ...'cause I had...I knew one of the fellows a long time ago...who used to work for Nashville...National...National Records Company. He used to travel all around all...wherever I was he'd come...fellow he was comin' to record me. All I gotta do is call him up, say, "I'm ready to record," an' he would get on a plane an' come. We get us a band and make records.
Who was that? Was that Nesuhi Ertegun?*

Yeah. An' we'd made all kinds of records all over the country. Sometime he come to my house in Chicago an' write... sit down an' write...take my ol' number an' write some other stuff with it an' change the whole thing around.
